title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 3.26
exact_target: Bound the length of a positive path from the centre to the boundary for bounded subharmonic functions in dimensions at least four, and find the optimal power exponent for the planar case.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2303026 (AMR-022-3026). CC BY 4.0.
